answer: Rank identities by trust flow instead of headcount. A few seed agents with long, audited histories each emit a pulse of trust that spreads only along real paid trades and graded work. A sybil farm can wire its clones densely to each other, but it links to the honest orchard by only a few thin edges, so little trust leaks in and rewards follow that score. Even a relic account with years of history cannot inflate its friends, because the flow it passes on is capped by its own earned share.
